criteria.name: Conflict of Interest & Funding Disclosure
criteria.description: Explicit statement showing no commercial stake OR full funding disclosures.

criteria.name: Publication Quality & Repository Provenance
criteria.description: Published in peer-reviewed venue or verified repository with permanent accession.

criteria.name: Data Origin & Independent Sampling
criteria.description: Data collected directly or from verified independent registries, not cherry-picked.

criteria.name: Replication & Transparent Failure Reporting
criteria.description: Independent replications documented and negative results / frozen failures openly logged.

categories.title: Question 2: How Does the Researcher Know?

criteria.name: Empirical Primary Data vs Pure Narrative
criteria.description: Based on empirical data, formal mathematical derivations, or machine-checked proofs.

criteria.name: Sample Size Adequacy & Power Calculation
criteria.description: Sample size explicitly justified with formal statistical power calculations.

criteria.name: Controls, Counter-Factuals & Blinding
criteria.description: Negative controls, shuffle permutations, or blinding mechanisms documented.

criteria.name: Appropriate Statistical Tests & Exact Reporting
criteria.description: Correct statistical tests specified with exact p-values, test statistics, and DF.

criteria.name: Absolute Risk Baselines Alongside Relative Rates
criteria.description: Absolute baselines, NNT, or NNH reported alongside relative percentages.

criteria.name: Confidence Intervals & Uncertainty Bounds
criteria.description: Confidence intervals (95% CI) or error bars reported on all primary and secondary outcomes.

criteria.name: Confounder & Covariate Adjustment
criteria.description: Multivariate controls, propensity scores, or covariate conditioning documented.

criteria.name: Exclusion, Dropout & Attrition Logs
criteria.description: All participant withdrawals, data filtering, and outlier exclusions fully logged.

categories.title: Question 4: Did Someone Change the Subject?

criteria.name: Construct Validity & Measurement Alignment
criteria.description: Operationalized measure matches the theoretical construct without semantic drift.

criteria.name: Generalization & Ecological Validity
criteria.description: Conclusions strictly bounded to the population and context tested without overreach.

criteria.name: Correlation vs. Causation Discipline
criteria.description: Correlational associations explicitly not described as causal mechanisms.

criteria.name: Visual Honesty & Un-Truncated Axes
criteria.description: Charts include zero baselines, proportional scaling, and un-truncated axes.

criteria.name: Objective Endpoint vs Unvalidated Surrogate
criteria.description: Measures objective, validated functional endpoints rather than uncalibrated proxies.

criteria.name: Longitudinal Follow-up & Temporal Horizon
criteria.description: Follow-up duration sufficient to observe chronic trajectory, decay, or rebound.

criteria.name: Biological & Physical Plausibility
criteria.description: Mechanisms conform to established thermodynamic and biophysical principles.

criteria.name: Independent Practical & Systemic Significance
criteria.description: Effect size is practically meaningful, not just statistically significant via massive N.
